messages:
ion: Heads-up — small design review: adding a 'lane drilldown' in Run History so users can keyboard-drill into nested structured outputs. Quick mock in Figma: https://figma.com/s/lanedrill maya: Love the idea. Two quick Qs: when users drill, does focus stay in the lane or shift to a separate inspector panel? ion: Plan is inline drill: Right arrow drills into the selected field, Left backs out. When drilled, focus moves to the first interactive element in the drill view. Esc closes and returns focus to the lane header. Visible focus ring required. courtney: Copy nit: use 'Result' instead of 'Output' for collapsed summaries. For breadcrumb-like drill header show short path e.g. 'user.address 7city' (keep short for translations). ben: A11y notes: add aria-current="true" on the active lane; role="tree"/treeitem for drill nodes, and announce drill events: "Drilled into user.address.city" via aria-live polite. Avoid announcing intermediate streaming updates. maya: Streaming behaviour — append visually but DO NOT auto-scroll if keyboard focus or text selection is inside the lane. Show a subtle "new" badge and a jump-to-bottom control. ion: Minimal ARIA snippet I'll drop into Figma: ```html
getUser() Structured 120ms
``` courtney: Also add a 'Copy path' quick action for breadcrumbs; announce "Path copied" on success and show a transient tooltip. Provide keyboard shortcut for power users (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+P). a11y-bot: Action items: ion -> update Figma frames + keyboard map; ben -> run SR session focused on drill flows; maya -> provide i18n length checks; courtney -> prepare copy variants. Ping this thread when ready for round 2. ion: Thanks all, will push updates later today and tag for review.
